contract: c1 apply checksum, verify, rollback, bundle and source digests
notes: manifest is the parsed migration.yaml (JSON data model). projectDefaults is the project configuration's defaults block. files holds UTF-8 file contents; an absent key is an absent file. expected.applyProjection, verifyProjection and rollbackProjection are the JCS texts of P, V and R. The digest layer does not check that files and manifest agree; bundle validation does that separately. expectedError names the first failure and, for SQL errors, the file.
